name: bundler-matrix-app
description: Standalone consumer fixture for the pack-based bundler-matrix gate. NOT part of the pnpm workspace: installed with npm at runtime so the packed @comvi tarballs resolve exactly like a published install (run.mjs adds the tarballs with `npm install --no-save`). rolldown is PINNED via overrides: 1.2.7 (2026-09-02) shipped without its native binding packages and breaks every fresh install; drop the override once upstream publishes working bindings.
